name: three-skill-workbench
description: A unified entry point for requirement analysis, browser UI exploration with optional risk profiles, and UI acceptance execution.

interface.shortDescription: Route testing workflows and optional specialist profiles.
interface.longDescription: Choose requirement analysis, reverse UI exploration, or UI acceptance execution by mode. Add profile=high-frequency for reusable risk probes, or profile=long-text for isolated 799-character checks across eligible text fields.
defaultPrompt: mode=requirement: review this requirement and design tests
mode=explore profile=high-frequency: probe common UI risks
mode=explore profile=long-text: check every eligible text field with an exact 799-character value
